acceptance: A SQL run and a DataFrame run at a scale with no reference record the same status and reason
A new result claiming 'passed' without per-query evidence is refused by validate_submission.py
Every stored result without evidence carries the derived label in the snapshot, and no rank changes
The 'not seed-aligned' reason appears only where a reference exists and the seed differs
Public validate_submission.py accepts a new result with the no-reference status and still refuses a failed one
The site validation-admission ADR amendment is merged and matches the allowlists
context: Step of the corpus rule remediation plan (crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan). Plan written 2026-11-22 and reviewed twice by an independent adversarial reviewer; counts marked (R) were measured by that reviewer and must be re-measured, not trusted. description:
## Problem
The same fact (no reference at this scale) is recorded as passed (older SQL results), not_validated (SQL since #4154) or uncertain (DataFrame), and the DataFrame TPC-DS reason says "not seed-aligned" where the fact is that no reference exists (T5). 407 of 411 stored 'passed' results carry no per-query evidence (R). Current writers still record passed with no evidence where no reference provider exists.

## Change
- One loader (core/expected_results) and one status vocabulary for both run types. 'passed' requires per-query evidence in the file. "No reference at this scale" is one status with one reason.
- The rule derives the label "row counts not checked" for any result, stored or new, without per-query evidence; such results stay ranked (owner decision 5). No stored file is edited.
- Public path: the no-reference status is admitted and ranks, as decisions 2 and 5 require. Change PUBLIC_CLEAN_VALIDATION_STATUS and the mirror allowlist (validation bundle.py) and amend the site validation-admission ADR (adr-corpus-validation-admission-policy.md) in a matching site pull request referenced from this one. A failed validation is still refused.
- Guard: a new result with 'passed' and no per-query evidence fails validation.

## Decision gates
- Count stored results that get the label and put the count in the pull request. If a stored result would change rank because of this item, stop: the owner decided they stay ranked.

## Guardrails (apply to every item of this plan)
- Fix the root cause for every platform and benchmark. No rule, exception, label or test may name a platform or a version matrix. Only the pvm-p* items may name Polars, and only to run and stage that run's files.
- Never edit a stored result file to make it pass. Outcomes change only through the rule.
- Any change to the outcome of a stored result must show in the committed outcome snapshot diff in the same pull request and be explained in its body.
- No new stored class value. No reader may decide anything from benchmark.compliance_class, conformance_class or summary.tpc_metrics.suppressed.
- Paths, line numbers and counts in this plan were read on 2026-11-22 at develop 93f3360. Re-read before editing; report drift, do not guess.
- AGENTS.md applies: linked worktree, one pull request per item, close at the merged pull request, heavy work only through make heavy-run, no live cloud run without owner approval in that task.
- At a decision gate, follow the recorded default. If its stop condition is met, stop and report to the owner. Never substitute a different owner decision.
- Read crr-00-corpus-rule-remediation-plan first: it holds the owner decisions, the rule table and the fault types (T1 to T5).
